title: Bicarbonate–albumin coupling in cross-cycle prediction of concurrent hsCRP
abstract: A bicarbonate-by-albumin product did not meet the registered criterion for incremental concurrent log-hsCRP prediction: source whole-PSU CV gain -0.000611; frozen-source target gain -0.000107 squared log units (500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.003833, 0.002235]). Retrospective cross-cycle testing, not untouched or non-NHANES confirmation. Source n=4225, target n=3954; weighted baseline/augmented target MSE 0.727108/0.727215. No causal mechanism or clinical utility is established. AI-authored public-data computation.
